options.content:
# Kyverno
A Kubernetes-native policy management engine

#### About this dashboard

This dashboard represents generic insights that can be extracted from a cluster with Kyverno running.

- **Policies (policies.kyverno.io)** rows cover `ValidatingPolicy`, `ImageValidatingPolicy`, `MutatingPolicy`, `GeneratingPolicy`, `DeletingPolicy` and their namespaced variants.
- **Legacy Policies (kyverno.io)** rows cover `ClusterPolicy` and `Policy`, and stay empty when no legacy policies are installed.

#### For more details around the metrics

Checkout the [official docs of Kyverno metrics](https://kyverno.io/docs/monitoring/)

panels.description: Percentage of fail results across ValidatingPolicy, ImageValidatingPolicy, MutatingPolicy and GeneratingPolicy evaluations (admission and background) in the last 24 hours. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
(sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
or vector(0)) * 100
/
sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Policy Failure Rate (Last 24 Hours)

panels.description: ValidatingPolicy and NamespacedValidatingPolicy resources evaluated in the selected time range. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.description: Percentage of fail results produced by background scans (reports controller, and GeneratingPolicy evaluations in the background controller) in the last 24 hours. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

(sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
or vector(0)) * 100
/
sum (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Background Scan Failure Rate (Last 24 Hours)

panels.description: ValidatingPolicy and ImageValidatingPolicy resources with the Deny validation action. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{policy_validation_mode="Deny", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{policy_validation_mode="Deny", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Enforcing (Deny) Validating Policies

panels.description: ValidatingPolicy and ImageValidatingPolicy resources without the Deny validation action. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{policy_validation_mode="Audit", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{policy_validation_mode="Audit", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Audit-only Validating Policies

panels.description: ValidatingPolicy, ImageValidatingPolicy and MutatingPolicy resources with background processing enabled. Counted from the result metrics: a policy is included when it produced at least one result in the selected time range (there is no inventory metric for policies.kyverno.io types).

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{policy_background_mode="true", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{policy_background_mode="true", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster, policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{policy_background_mode="true", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Background-enabled Policies

panels.description: Results of ValidatingPolicy, ImageValidatingPolicy and MutatingPolicy evaluations during admission review, per 5 minutes. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
sum by (result) (
  label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Admission Review Results

panels.description: Results of policy evaluations during background processing (reports controller scans and GeneratingPolicy evaluations), per 5 minutes. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
sum by (result) (
  label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (result) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Background Scan Results

panels.description: Fail results per 5 minutes, split by policy kind. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
sum by (policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Policy Failures (by policy kind)

panels.description: Admission review results per policy, per 5 minutes. Cluster-scoped policies are shown with namespace '-'. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="admission_request", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
),
"policy_namespace", "-", "policy_namespace", "")

panels.title: Admission Review Results (per-policy)

panels.description: Background processing results per policy, per 5 minutes. Cluster-scoped policies are shown with namespace '-'. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, result) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{execution_cause="background_scan", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
),
"policy_namespace", "-", "policy_namespace", "")

panels.title: Background Scan Results (per-policy)

panels.description: Policies with the most fail results in the last 24 hours. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
topk(10,
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0),
"policy_namespace", "-", "policy_namespace", "")

panels.title: Top 10 Failing Policies (Last 24 Hours)

panels.description: Resource kinds that received the most fail results in the last 24 hours, across all policy kinds.

targets.expr:
topk(10,
sum by (resource_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (resource_kind) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (resource_kind) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (resource_kind) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (resource_kind) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_results_total{result="fail", cluster=~"$cluster"}[24h])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
> 0)

panels.title: Top 10 Resource Kinds with Failures (Last 24 Hours)

panels.description: Average time spent evaluating a single policy against a resource, over 5 minute windows. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
sum by (policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
/
sum by (policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum (rate(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)

panels.title: Average Policy Execution Latency (by policy kind)

panels.description: 95th percentile time spent evaluating a single policy against a resource, over 5 minute windows. Accuracy depends on the configured histogram bucket boundaries. Namespaced variants (e.g. NamespacedValidatingPolicy) are reported under the same policy kind.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.95,
sum by (le, policy_kind) (
  label_replace(sum by (le) (rate(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (rate(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (rate(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (rate(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
)

panels.title: p95 Policy Execution Latency (by policy kind)

panels.description: Average policy execution latency across all policies.kyverno.io kinds in the selected time range.

)

panels.title: Average Policy Execution Latency

panels.description: 95th percentile policy execution latency across all policies.kyverno.io kinds in the selected time range.

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.95,
sum by (le) (
  label_replace(sum by (le) (increase(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "ImageValidatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (increase(kyverno_mutating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "MutatingPolicy", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (le) (increase(kyverno_generating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])), "policy_kind", "GeneratingPolicy", "", "")
)
)

panels.title: p95 Policy Execution Latency

panels.description: Average execution latency per policy, over 5 minute windows.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
sum by (policy_namespace, policy_name) (rate(kyverno_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]))
